conventions: Slack bus: DE-663, the highest-voltage bus with the most line connections. The source says nothing about where the reference angle sits; this is a convention, not a fact about the network.
Voltage limits of 0.95-1.05 pu on every bus, and angle limits of +/-0.6 rad on every line, are placeholders of the same kind.

excluded.islands: Five buses in four fragments, each a converter station or a stub that no AC circuit in the extract connects to the synchronous network.
excluded.hvdc: Converter stations and their links are not modelled. The north-south corridors under construction and the interconnectors to Scandinavia are absent, so transfer capability is understated.
